Thank you for the interest — and a heads-up before you spend time on this.

**RatNav does not take pull requests.** Not because contributions are unwelcome, but because
running a review process is a commitment a one-person side project cannot make, and leaving a PR
open for months would be worse than saying so now.

What does help:

- **Open an issue** for a bug, especially a wrong marker, a map that will not load, or a quest that
  reads incorrectly. Those are how anything gets found.
- **Fork it.** The [licence](../LICENSE) allows it for anything noncommercial. Give your version its
  own name so nobody downloads it expecting this one.
- **Settle a map.** If a map is held back for calibration, one screenshot fixes it for everyone —
  see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
